d.seg: बट आप कुछ चंद पैसों के लिए एक काम करो बराबर
d.tr: But you do one thing for a few money, equal
d.j: The user is indirectly linking payment to a service by asking the other party to do something for money.

d.seg: मैं आपको तीन सौ रुपयए दूंगा चार सौ रुपयए दूंगा पांच सौ रुपयए दूंगा
d.tr: I will give you three hundred rupees, four hundred rupees, five hundred rupees
d.j: The user is explicitly offering payment amounts in the context of the conversation, suggesting a transactional nature.

d.seg: तीन सौ रुपये में आप बॉडी दिखा रहे हो सबको ठीक है
d.tr: You are showing your body for three hundred rupees, okay
d.j: The user is explicitly linking a monetary amount to the act of showing one's body.

d.seg: देखो अगर आपने व्हाट्सप वीडियो कॉल बोला ठीक है
d.tr: Look, if you said WhatsApp video call, okay
d.j: The user explicitly suggested moving the conversation to an external communication application (WhatsApp).
